parsed.note_claim: Ecevit was informed early on the morning of the earthquake, visited the region by helicopter the same day, and gave a statement to TRT (contradicting the claim he went to Yalova 2-3 days later).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Bülent Ecevit ilk gün geldi, 17 Ağustos'ta sabah 6.00-6.30 gibi bölgedeydim. Saat 8.00 gibi de TRT olarak biz canlı yayındaydık. Tam saatini hatırlamıyorum ama öğle saatlerinde Bülent Ecevit Adapazarı'na geldi.
parsed.reason: The Teyit page documents that Ecevit arrived at the Başbakanlık early on Aug 17, 1999, toured the region by helicopter that day, and spoke to TRT, directly substantiating the note's claims (though the note says 2002 where the page covers the 1999 quake).
